title: Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
title_zh: 信任工具：LLM漏洞审计智能体对静态分析证据的非对称性遵从

paragraphs.en: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser’s output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C/C++ that produces proof obligations and audited vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul under six evidence conditions that differ only in the notes, including fabricated assurances that a missing check exists and fabricated alarms that an added check is missing. The study covers 916 pairs in four disjoint sets, eleven model configurations from four vendors and 16,572 audits; no model is trained or fine-tuned. True evidence barely improved accuracy ( + 0.02 +0.02 ). False evidence acted asymmetrically: relative to true notes about the same operations, false assurances lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 points, whereas false alarms never significantly lowered accuracy and were disputed far more often. An internally registered replication on seven new models confirmed that false assurances move verdicts towards their claim more than false alarms do (mean asymmetry + 0.16 +0.16 , 95% CI + 0.10 +0.10 to + 0.24 +0.24 ). Instructions in the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference; the best one failed to replicate. Verifying each claim in a separate call and showing the refuted claims raised accuracy under false assurances by 12 points in a pre-specified test ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ) without loss under true evidence; for a second model the gain was smaller and not significant. Pipelines should therefore verify a tool’s guarantees before the model relies on them, and studies should measure deference in a direction-aware way.

paragraphs.en: Keywords: Automation bias, empirical study, human–AI interaction, large language models, static analysis, vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：自动化偏见、实证研究、人机交互、大语言模型、静态分析、漏洞检测。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to audit code for vulnerabilities, and a natural way to make them more reliable is to give them the output of program analysis. Systems that combine LLMs with static analysis let the analyser enumerate candidate defects and ask the model to judge them [ 1 , 2 ] , or let the model triage the analyser’s warnings [ 3 , 4 ] . In all of these designs the model consumes evidence produced by a tool, and the value of the combination depends on how the model treats that evidence: whether it uses true evidence, and whether it notices when the evidence is wrong. Static analysers are wrong often enough that developers cite false positives as a main reason not to use them [ 5 ] , and the same analysers can also be wrong in the other direction, reporting that a guard exists or that a path is safe when it is not.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于审计代码中的漏洞，而提升其可靠性的一种自然方式是向其提供程序分析的输出。 将大语言模型与静态分析相结合的系统，既可以让分析器枚举候选缺陷并交由模型进行判断 [ 1 , 2 ] ，也可以让模型对分析器发出的警告进行分诊 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 在所有这些设计中，模型都会消费由工具产生的证据，而这种组合的价值取决于模型如何对待这些证据：它是否使用了真实的证据，以及当证据出错时它是否能察觉。 静态分析器的出错频率之高，以至于开发者将误报列为不使用它们的主要原因之一 [ 5 ] ，而且这些分析器也会朝另一个方向出错，即在实际不存在防护或路径不安全的情况下，报告称防护存在或路径是安全的。

paragraphs.en: How people treat the output of automated aids has been studied for decades under the name of automation bias: people over-rely on automation, accept its errors of commission, and miss what it fails to flag [ 6 , 7 ] . Recent work in human–AI interaction shows the same pattern with AI assistants, where explanations can increase rather than reduce over-reliance [ 8 ] and fluent assistance can create confidence without competence [ 9 ] . LLMs that consume tool output are in the position of the human user. Work on knowledge conflicts shows that LLMs can be highly receptive to external evidence that contradicts what they know [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , and work on sycophancy shows that they tend to agree with the views put to them [ 13 ] . Concurrent work has begun to show that context outside the code, such as prior verdicts, pull-request metadata and comments, shifts the verdicts of LLM security reviewers [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] . These studies vary cues that are not tied to the truth of a specific claim, or study only claims that the code is safe. The closest, ALIBI [ 16 ] , already embeds fabricated tool reports in code comments to evade LLM detectors, but it studies only claims of safety and does not compare a false claim with a true claim about the same operation. Our study adds three things: true and false evidence matched on the same operations, false claims in both directions, and mitigations evaluated on held-out data. Whether LLM auditors distinguish true from false analysis evidence about the same operations, and whether their scrutiny depends on the direction of the claim, has not been measured.

paragraphs.en: This paper reports a controlled empirical study of that question. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C and C++ that produces proof obligations : for each sensitive operation, the guards that hold on every path to it and what the function does not guarantee. Running it on pairs of vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul [ 17 ] , we audit the same function under six evidence conditions that vary only the notes: none, all true notes, true notes about the operations the fix touches, true notes about other operations, a fabricated assurance that the missing check exists, and a fabricated alarm that the check added by the fix is missing. Because both false conditions are compared with true notes about the same operations, differences in the verdicts can be attributed to the truth of the evidence. All models are used through their APIs for inference only; no model training or fine-tuning is performed. We ask four research questions: whether true evidence helps (RQ1), how relevance and correctness affect the verdicts (RQ2), whether the models check the evidence (RQ3), and whether the way evidence is presented can reduce deference to false evidence (RQ4).

paragraphs.en: LLMs are now applied across software engineering tasks [ 20 , 21 ] , and vulnerability detection is one of the most studied. Before LLMs, deep learning detectors learned from token sequences, code gadgets or program graphs [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] , trained on datasets mined from vulnerability-fixing commits [ 25 , 26 ] . Such detectors have repeatedly been found to perform far worse under realistic evaluation than on their original benchmarks [ 27 ] . Risse and Böhme showed that state-of-the-art models overfit to features unrelated to the vulnerability and cannot distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched versions [ 28 ] . PrimeVul [ 17 ] addressed label noise and data duplication and introduced paired evaluation; on it, code language models, including large general-purpose LLMs, rarely judge both versions of a pair correctly. Studies focusing on LLMs report the same picture: answers are non-deterministic, reasoning is often incorrect or unfaithful, and small semantics-preserving changes alter verdicts [ 29 ] . Prompting strategies and in-context information improve results only modestly [ 30 , 31 ] . Steenhoek et al. argue that vulnerability detection requires multi-step reasoning about code semantics, such as relating bounds and null checks to the operations they protect, and that this reasoning is where LLMs fail [ 32 ] . Our preliminary study ( Section 3 ) agrees: the models we study make almost no errors about local program structure, so their errors are judgements, not misreadings. We use PrimeVul’s paired data and its paired metrics, but our dependent variable is not detection performance; it is how detection changes when the model is given evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型如今已被应用于各类软件工程任务 [ 20 , 21 ] ，其中漏洞检测是研究最多的方向之一。 在大语言模型出现之前，深度学习检测器从词元序列、代码片段或程序图中学习 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] ，并在从漏洞修复提交中挖掘的数据集上训练 [ 25 , 26 ] 。 此类检测器在真实评估下的表现反复被证实远差于其原始基准上的表现 [ 27 ] 。 Risse 和 Böhme 证明了最先进的模型会过拟合到与漏洞无关的特征上，无法将有漏洞的函数与其补丁后的版本区分开来 [ 28 ] 。 PrimeVul [ 17 ] 解决了标签噪声和数据重复问题，并引入了成对评估；在该基准上，包括大型通用大语言模型在内的代码语言模型很少能同时对一对样本的两个版本都做出正确判断。 专注于大语言模型的研究报告了同样的情况：答案具有非确定性，推理常常不正确或不忠实，而微小的保持语义的改动就会改变判断结果 [ 29 ] 。 提示策略和上下文信息仅能带来有限的改进 [ 30 , 31 ] 。 Steenhoek 等人认为，漏洞检测需要对代码语义进行多步推理，例如将边界检查和空指针检查与其所保护的操作关联起来，而这种推理正是大语言模型失败之处 [ 32 ] 。 我们的初步研究（第 3 节）印证了这一点：我们所研究的模型在局部程序结构上几乎没有出错，因此它们的错误是判断错误，而非误读。 我们使用 PrimeVul 的成对数据及其成对指标，但我们的因变量不是检测性能，而是模型在获得证据后检测结果如何变化。

sents.en: We use PrimeVul’s paired data and its paired metrics, but our dependent variable is not detection performance; it is how detection changes when the model is given evidence.

paragraphs.en: Static analysers trade completeness for precision in ways that limit their adoption. They miss many real bugs [ 33 ] , and their false positives are a main reason why developers ignore or abandon them [ 5 , 34 , 35 ] . A body of work therefore post-processes static-analysis alarms to identify the actionable ones [ 36 ] , although learned alarm classifiers have been found to benefit from data leakage in their evaluation [ 37 ] . LLMs offer a new way to perform this triage, and more generally to use tools as part of their reasoning [ 38 , 39 ] . A growing line of work combines LLMs with static analysis. LLift uses an LLM to examine the candidate bugs of a static analyser for the Linux kernel and to discard those whose preconditions are ruled out [ 1 ] ; an earlier pilot used ChatGPT to prune the analyser’s false positives [ 3 ] . IRIS lets an LLM infer taint specifications that a static analyser then uses for whole-repository detection [ 2 ] . In industry, hybrid pipelines in which an LLM adjudicates static-analysis alarms remove most false positives while keeping high recall [ 4 ] , and general-purpose coding agents can filter most false positives of security analysers, at the risk of also suppressing real vulnerabilities [ 40 ] . In all of these designs, analysis results enter the model’s context as evidence. Their evaluations measure the end result of the pipeline; they do not isolate how the model treats correct and incorrect evidence. Our study complements them: we hold the code and the model fixed and vary only the truth, relevance and presentation of the evidence.

paragraphs.en: Natural language processing research has studied how LLMs resolve conflicts between their parametric knowledge and evidence in their context. LLMs can be highly receptive to coherent external evidence even when it contradicts what they know, while also showing confirmation bias towards evidence that agrees with them [ 10 ] ; the literature on such knowledge conflicts is surveyed by Xu et al. [ 11 ] . ClashEval found that models adopt incorrect retrieved content over their own correct answer in more than 60% of cases, and less often the more implausible the error is [ 12 ] . A related tendency, sycophancy, makes models agree with the views of the user [ 41 , 13 ] , and models often abandon a correct answer when it is challenged, even by invalid arguments [ 42 ] . These studies vary the content of factual evidence in question answering. We study evidence about program behaviour, which the model can check against the code it is given, and we find that the direction of the evidence (whether it says that the code is safe or that it is unsafe) determines whether it is checked.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言处理研究已经探讨了大型语言模型如何解决其参数化知识与上下文中证据之间的冲突。 大型语言模型对连贯的外部证据可能高度接受，即使该证据与其已知内容相矛盾，同时对与其观点一致的证据表现出确认偏误 [ 10 ] ；Xu 等人 [ 11 ] 对有关此类知识冲突的文献进行了综述。 ClashEval 发现，模型在超过 60% 的情况下会采用检索到的不正确内容而放弃自己正确的答案，且错误越不合理，这种情况越少发生 [ 12 ] 。 一种相关的倾向是谄媚性，它使模型认同用户的观点 [ 41 , 13 ] ，而且当正确答案受到质疑时，模型常常会放弃该答案，即使质疑使用的是无效论证 [ 42 ] 。 这些研究在问答任务中改变事实性证据的内容。 我们研究的是关于程序行为的证据，模型可以将其与所给代码进行核对，我们发现证据的倾向（即它说代码是安全的还是不安全的）决定了它是否会被核对。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent work shows that LLM security verdicts depend on context outside the code. Shahriar et al. add author attributions, task framings and prior analysis outcomes (a function “marked SAFE” or “VULNERABLE” in an automated analysis) to PrimeVul functions and find that all eight models they study are susceptible; they conclude that such cues mainly change how willing a model is to flag code rather than how well it discriminates [ 14 ] . Alexopoulos et al. show that crafted pull-request metadata biases LLM-based code review and, with iterative refinement, hides 32 of 33 real vulnerabilities from production pipelines, while blunt templates can backfire because they raise suspicion [ 15 ] . ALIBI uses code comments with fabricated safety claims, including fabricated tool reports, to evade LLM detectors, and finds that isolating the code from unverifiable comments defends better than instructions to distrust them [ 16 ] . In contrast, Thornton finds that adversarial comments have no significant effect on frontier models in a benchmark of 100 samples [ 43 ] . Beyond verdicts, correct vulnerability verdicts are often accompanied by fabricated or unverifiable reasoning [ 44 ] , and in code smell detection, models adopt false premises in the prompt unless asked to reason from evidence first [ 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 并行研究显示，大语言模型的安全判定取决于代码之外的上下文。 Shahriar 等人向 PrimeVul 函数中添加作者署名、任务表述以及先前分析结果（如自动化分析中某函数被标记为“SAFE”或“VULNERABLE”），发现他们研究的全部八个模型都易受影响；他们得出结论：这类线索主要改变的是模型标记代码的意愿，而非其辨别能力 [ 14 ] 。 Alexopoulos 等人表明，精心构造的拉取请求元数据会使基于大语言模型的代码审查产生偏差，并通过迭代优化，使 33 个真实漏洞中的 32 个躲过了生产流水线的检测；而粗糙直白的模板反而可能适得其反，因为它们会引起怀疑 [ 15 ] 。 ALIBI 使用带有捏造安全性声明的代码注释（包括捏造的工具报告）来规避大语言模型检测器，并发现将代码与不可验证的注释隔离开，比通过指令让模型不信任这些注释的防御效果更好 [ 16 ] 。 与之相反，Thornton 在一个包含 100 个样本的基准测试中发现，对抗性注释对前沿模型没有显著影响 [ 43 ] 。 除判定结果之外，正确的漏洞判定往往伴随捏造或不可验证的推理过程 [ 44 ] ；在代码坏味检测中，除非被要求先基于证据进行推理，否则模型会采纳提示中的错误前提 [ 45 ] 。

paragraphs.en: LLMs produce fluent statements that are unsupported by their input or by facts, a behaviour broadly termed hallucination [ 46 , 47 ] . Generating a chain of reasoning improves multi-step reasoning [ 48 ] , but the stated reasoning need not reflect what determines the answer [ 49 ] . Whether models can correct their own errors is contested: iterative self-feedback improves some tasks [ 50 ] , but without external feedback models generally fail to correct their reasoning and may make it worse [ 51 ] , and self-correction works best when reliable external feedback is available [ 52 ] . Chain-of-Verification reduces hallucination by having the model plan verification questions about its draft, answer them independently and revise the draft [ 53 ] . Our verify-show strategy follows the same principle of independent verification, applied to the tool’s claims rather than to the model’s own draft; the code under audit serves as the external reference against which the claims are checked.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型会生成缺乏输入依据或事实依据的流畅陈述，这种行为通常被称为幻觉 [ 46 , 47 ] 。 生成推理链可以提升多步推理能力 [ 48 ] ，但所陈述的推理未必反映决定答案的真实因素 [ 49 ] 。 模型能否纠正自身错误仍存争议：迭代式自我反馈可改进某些任务 [ 50 ] ，但在缺乏外部反馈的情况下，模型通常无法纠正自身的推理，甚至可能使其更糟 [ 51 ] ，而自我校正在有可靠外部反馈可用时效果最佳 [ 52 ] 。 验证链通过让模型为其草稿规划验证问题、独立回答这些问题并修订草稿，从而减少幻觉 [ 53 ] 。 我们的「验证-展示」策略遵循同样的独立验证原则，但应用于工具的断言而非智能体自身的草稿；被审计的代码充当外部参照，断言即对照该参照进行检查。

paragraphs.en: Human factors research distinguishes misuse of automation, that is over-reliance, from disuse, which is often caused by false alarms [ 6 ] ; appropriate reliance requires trust to be calibrated to the actual reliability of the aid [ 54 ] . Automation bias produces two kinds of error: errors of commission, when people follow incorrect advice, and errors of omission, when they miss problems the aid did not flag [ 55 ] . A systematic review of automation bias in clinical decision support found that incorrect advice leads to errors of commission, and identified the presentation of advice and the user’s verification effort as mediators [ 7 ] . In AI-assisted decision making, explanations can increase over-reliance [ 56 ] ; they reduce it when verifying the AI’s output is easy relative to solving the task alone [ 57 ] . Cognitive forcing functions, such as asking people to decide before they see the AI’s recommendation, also reduce over-reliance [ 8 ] . Recent work on LLM-assisted knowledge work finds that fluent assistance produces high perceived understanding with the lowest actual learning [ 9 ] . We transfer these concepts to an LLM that is the user of a tool: we ask whether the model over-relies on the tool’s assurances, and we test interventions analogous to those studied with people, namely framing, provenance, independent verification and a commit-first variant of cognitive forcing.
paragraphs.zh: 人因研究将自动化的误用（即过度依赖）与弃用区分开来，弃用往往由误报引起 [ 6 ]；恰当的依赖要求信任度与辅助工具的实际可靠性相校准 [ 54 ]。 自动化偏差会导致两类错误：代发性错误，即人们遵循了错误的建议；以及遗漏性错误，即人们漏掉了辅助工具未标记出的问题 [ 55 ]。 一项关于临床决策支持中自动化偏差的系统综述发现，错误的建议会导致代发性错误，并指出建议的呈现方式与用户的核验投入是中介因素 [ 7 ]。 在AI辅助决策中，解释可能加剧过度依赖 [ 56]；当核验AI输出相对于独立完成任务较为容易时，解释则会减少过度依赖 [ 57 ]。 认知强制函数，例如让人们在看到AI建议之前先自行作出决定，也能减少过度依赖 [ 8 ]。 近期关于LLM辅助知识工作的研究发现，流畅的辅助会带来较高的感知理解，而实际学习效果却最低 [ 9 ]。 我们将这些概念迁移到作为工具用户的LLM上：我们探究模型是否会过度依赖工具的保证，并测试与针对人类所研究的干预措施类似的手段，即框架提示、来源标注、独立核验以及认知强制的一种“先提交”变体。

paragraphs.en: Empirical software engineering has long-standing guidelines for controlled experiments [ 58 ] and for the statistical analysis of stochastic results [ 59 ] . LLM-based studies add threats of their own: closed models change behind their APIs, training data may overlap with evaluation data, and outputs are non-deterministic even at temperature zero [ 60 , 61 ] , while results can depend on seemingly irrelevant details of prompt formatting [ 62 ] . Pre-registration commits to hypotheses and analyses before the data are seen, which separates confirmatory from exploratory findings and prevents selective reporting [ 18 ] . It has been adopted by software engineering venues in the form of registered reports [ 19 ] . Studies of LLMs are especially exposed to the garden of forking paths, because prompts can be varied without limit; we therefore separate development and test data and fix the hypotheses of the confirmatory phases in advance.

paragraphs.en: Work on LLM vulnerability detection measures how well models flag code, not how they use evidence; work that combines LLMs with static analysis evaluates whole pipelines, not the model’s treatment of correct and incorrect evidence; and work on knowledge conflicts studies factual evidence in question answering that the model cannot check against its input. Concurrent studies of contextual bias in security review come closest, and our study differs from them in three ways. First, our evidence consists of specific claims about the operations in the function, which the model can check against the code, and each false claim is compared with a true claim about the same operation; this isolates the truth of the evidence from its presence. Second, we compare false claims in both directions on matched functions and show that the models scrutinise them differently: they check alarms and trust assurances. A pure change in willingness to flag, as reported for generic cues [ 14 ] , would move verdicts by similar amounts in both directions; our direction-aware measure shows that it does not. Third, we evaluate mitigations in a pre-specified test on held-out data. The adversarial studies above examine only claims that code is safe; our results explain why that is the direction an attacker would choose. The asymmetry also bears directly on alarm triage, where the model is asked to dismiss alarms, and on designs that pass the analyser’s guarantees to the model as context.
paragraphs.zh: 关于LLM漏洞检测的研究衡量的是模型标记代码的能力，而非其使用证据的方式；将LLM与静态分析相结合的研究评估的是整个流水线，而非模型对正确与错误证据的处理；而关于知识冲突的研究则考察问答中模型无法对照其输入进行核验的事实性证据。 关于安全审查中情境偏差的并行研究与我们的工作最为接近，而我们的研究与其有三点不同。 首先，我们的证据由关于函数中操作的具体断言构成，模型可以对照代码进行核验，并且每条错误断言都与关于同一操作的正确断言进行对比；这将证据的真伪与其是否存在分离开来。 其次，我们在匹配的函数上对两个方向的错误断言进行比较，并表明模型对它们的审查方式不同：模型会核查警报，却信任保证。 如针对一般性线索所报告的那样[ 14 ]，单纯的标记意愿变化会使判定在两个方向上以相近幅度偏移；而我们的方向感知度量表明事实并非如此。 第三，我们在预留数据上通过预先设定的测试评估缓解措施。 上述对抗性研究只考察声称代码安全的断言；我们的结果解释了为什么攻击者会选择这个方向。 这种不对称性还直接关系到警报分诊——模型被要求驳回警报的场景——以及那些将分析器的保证作为上下文传递给模型的设计方案。

paragraphs.en: The design of the main study grew out of two preliminary experiments with deepseek-chat . The first asked whether LLMs misread program structure, which static analysis could correct; the second whether static-analysis facts improve vulnerability audits.
paragraphs.zh: 主研究的设计源于两项使用 deepseek-chat 的初步实验。 第一项实验探讨大语言模型是否会误读程序结构，而静态分析能否纠正这一问题；第二项实验探讨静态分析提供的事实能否改进漏洞审计。

paragraphs.en: We asked the model to predict the output of Python programs from CRUXEval [ 63 ] (50 samples) and from the HumanEval part of REval [ 64 ] (85 samples), reasoning step by step. We extracted the factual claims of each reasoning chain into a small predicate language (for example, that a line executes, that a branch is taken, how often a loop iterates or what value a variable holds) and labelled each claim against the program’s control and data flow (static claims) or against an execution trace recorded in an isolated process (dynamic claims). With step-by-step reasoning, accuracy was saturated: 0.98 on CRUXEval and 1.00 on REval, against 0.88 and 0.89 for direct answers. Of 1,257 labelled claims, none of the 337 static claims was wrong; the errors were confined to run-specific values (3.0% of 234 dynamic claims on CRUXEval and 0.4% of 686 on REval), such as miscounted lengths or loop iterations, and several of them occurred in chains whose final answer was correct. A verifier that checked the static claims against the program graphs therefore had nothing to correct.

paragraphs.en: We then gave the model the obligations of our C/C++ analyser ( Section 4.3 ) while auditing 30 PrimeVul pairs. Plain step-by-step auditing judged 10 pairs correctly. Adding the facts gave 11; presenting them as a checklist of obligations to discharge reduced the number to 5–6, because the model judged more functions SAFE once it had worked through the listed obligations; a refinement step that asked the model to revisit its verdict in the light of the concerns gave 9, and five of its seven changed verdicts were patched functions turned into false alarms. Reading the answers, we found that the model’s local claims about the code were almost always correct; its errors were omissions and judgements, and in several cases it abandoned a correct judgement of its own in favour of a note.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，在审计 30 对 PrimeVul 样本时，我们让模型承担了我们 C/C++ 分析器的各项义务（第 4.3 节）。 简单的逐步审计正确判断了 10 对样本。 加入事实后达到 11 对；而以待履行义务清单的形式呈现这些事实，则将数量降至 5–6 对，因为模型在逐项核对清单中的义务后，会将更多函数判定为 SAFE；一个要求模型根据相关疑虑重新审视其判定结果的改进步骤使数量达到 9 对，其中七个改判中有五个是被 patch 修复过的函数被误判为误报。 阅读模型的回答后，我们发现其对代码的局部论断几乎总是正确的；其错误源于遗漏和判断失误，且在若干情况下，它会放弃自己原本正确的判断而采纳某条备注。

paragraphs.en: The two experiments shifted our question. The models do not need static analysis to see the structure of the code; what matters is how they weigh what the analysis tells them. This question cannot be answered on 30 pairs or by measuring accuracy alone. The main study therefore manipulates the evidence while keeping the code fixed, scales the data and the models, and separates exploratory from confirmatory analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 这两项实验改变了我们的问题。 这些模型不需要静态分析就能看到代码的结构；关键在于它们如何权衡分析所告诉它们的信息。 这个问题无法通过 30 对数据或仅测量准确率来回答。 因此，主研究在保持代码不变的情况下操纵证据，扩大数据和模型的规模，并将探索性分析与验证性分析分开。

sents.zh: 这些模型不需要静态分析就能看到代码的结构；关键在于它们如何权衡分析所告诉它们的信息。

sents.en: This question cannot be answered on 30 pairs or by measuring accuracy alone.
sents.zh: 这个问题无法通过 30 对数据或仅测量准确率来回答。

sents.en: The main study therefore manipulates the evidence while keeping the code fixed, scales the data and the models, and separates exploratory from confirmatory analyses.
sents.zh: 因此，主研究在保持代码不变的情况下操纵证据，扩大数据和模型的规模，并将探索性分析与验证性分析分开。

paragraphs.en: We study how an LLM that audits a C/C++ function for vulnerabilities uses static-analysis evidence about that function. The design manipulates the evidence while keeping the code, the model and the task fixed, so that differences in the model’s verdicts can be attributed to the evidence. This section describes the research questions ( Section 4.1 ), the data ( Section 4.2 ), how the evidence is produced and manipulated ( Sections 4.3 and 4.4 ), the measures and statistics ( Section 4.5 ), and the validation of the behavioural coding ( Section 4.6 ); Section 5 describes the models, the audit task and the protocol that separates exploration from confirmation. Fig. 1 summarises the design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究对 C/C++ 函数进行漏洞审计的大语言模型如何使用关于该函数的静态分析证据。 该设计在保持代码、模型和任务不变的情况下操纵证据，从而使模型判定结果的差异可以归因于证据。 本节描述研究问题（第 4.1 节）、数据（第 4.2 节）、证据的产生与操纵方式（第 4.3 和 4.4 节）、度量与统计方法（第 4.5 节），以及行为编码的验证（第 4.6 节）；第 5 节描述模型、审计任务以及将探索与确认分离的实验方案。 图 1 概括了该设计。

paragraphs.en: We use PrimeVul [ 17 ] , a vulnerability dataset with de-duplicated, manually validated labels. Its paired subsets contain, for each vulnerability-fixing commit, the vulnerable version of a function and its patched version. Pairs are well suited to our questions: a model that truly reasons about the code should flag the vulnerable version and clear the patched one, and the patch localises the code that matters. We take the release v0.1 of the paired splits and link the two versions of a pair through their commit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 PrimeVul [ 17 ]，这是一个经过去重并人工验证标签的漏洞数据集。 其配对子集针对每个修复漏洞的提交，包含函数的漏洞版本及其修补后的版本。 配对数据非常契合我们的研究问题：真正能够对代码进行推理的模型应当标记出漏洞版本并放行修补后的版本，而且补丁可以定位出关键的代码。 我们采用配对划分的 v0.1 发布版本，并通过提交将每一对中的两个版本关联起来。

paragraphs.en: From the paired test split (433 linkable pairs) we keep pairs whose CWE (Common Weakness Enumeration) category describes a structural defect that intraprocedural evidence can speak to (out-of-bounds access: CWE-119/120/122/125/787; NULL dereference: CWE-476; use after free, double free and leaks: CWE-416/415/401; divide by zero and integer over/underflow: CWE-369/190/191; infinite loop: CWE-835), whose two versions differ, and whose versions both have at most 150 lines. This yields 187 pairs (374 functions) from 60 projects; the largest are TensorFlow (38 pairs), the Linux kernel (26) and Vim (14), and the most frequent CWEs are out-of-bounds write (CWE-787, 46 pairs), NULL dereference (CWE-476, 32) and out-of-bounds read (CWE-125, 28).
paragraphs.zh: 从配对的测试集划分（433 个可关联对）中，我们保留满足以下条件的对：其 CWE（Common Weakness Enumeration，常见弱点枚举）类别描述的是过程内证据能够说明的结构性缺陷（越界访问：CWE-119/120/122/125/787；空指针解引用：CWE-476；释放后使用、重复释放与内存泄漏：CWE-416/415/401；除零与整数上溢/下溢：CWE-369/190/191；无限循环：CWE-835）；其两个版本存在差异；且其两个版本的代码行数均不超过 150 行。 由此得到来自 60 个项目的 187 个对（374 个函数）；其中规模最大的是 TensorFlow（38 个对）、Linux 内核（26 个）和 Vim（14 个），最常见的是越界写入（CWE-787，46 个对）、空指针解引用（CWE-476，32 个）和越界读取（CWE-125，28 个）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate presentation strategies without fitting them to the data they are evaluated on, we use two further splits that we did not inspect before the corresponding phase ( Section 5.3 ). The development set contains all 237 eligible pairs of the paired validation split. The test set is a random sample (seed 7) of 300 of the 1,390 eligible pairs of the paired training split; since we do not train models, the training split is simply unseen data. No function hash is shared between the three splits.

paragraphs.en: To produce evidence whose truth we control, we implemented an intraprocedural analyser for C and C++ on top of tree-sitter [ 65 ] . For a function it lists the sensitive operations (array indexing, pointer offsets, dereferences of pointers obtained from calls, frees, divisions, copy and allocation sizes, and computed length arguments) and, for each operation, a proof obligation with two parts:
paragraphs.zh: 为了产生其真实性可控的证据，我们在 tree-sitter [ 65 ] 之上实现了一个面向 C 和 C++ 的过程内分析器。 对于一个函数，它列出敏感操作（数组索引、指针偏移、对从调用获得的指针的解引用、释放、除法、拷贝与分配大小，以及计算出的长度参数），并且对每个操作给出一个由两部分组成的证明义务：

sents.en: To produce evidence whose truth we control, we implemented an intraprocedural analyser for C and C++ on top of tree-sitter [ 65 ] .
sents.zh: 为了产生其真实性可控的证据，我们在 tree-sitter [ 65 ] 之上实现了一个面向 C 和 C++ 的过程内分析器。

sents.en: For a function it lists the sensitive operations (array indexing, pointer offsets, dereferences of pointers obtained from calls, frees, divisions, copy and allocation sizes, and computed length arguments) and, for each operation, a proof obligation with two parts:
sents.zh: 对于一个函数，它列出敏感操作（数组索引、指针偏移、对从调用获得的指针的解引用、释放、除法、拷贝与分配大小，以及计算出的长度参数），并且对每个操作给出一个由两部分组成的证明义务：

paragraphs.en: holds here : the conditions that hold on every path reaching the operation, derived from enclosing if / else arms, loop conditions, the left operands of short-circuit operators and ternaries, and earlier early-exit checks in enclosing blocks (after if (c) return; the condition !c holds);
paragraphs.zh: 此处成立的条件（holds here）：在到达该操作的每条路径上都成立的条件，这些条件来自外层的 if / else 分支、循环条件、短路运算符和三元运算符的左操作数，以及外层代码块中更早的提前退出检查（在 if (c) return; 之后，条件 !c 成立）；

paragraphs.en: concern : what the function itself does not guarantee, for example a missing upper or lower bound on an index, a signed index without a non-negativity check, a size computed with a multiplication of unbounded values, a use after a free, or a return path that drops an allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 关注点：函数本身不能保证的内容，例如索引缺少上界或下界检查、有符号索引缺少非负性检查、使用无界值相乘计算大小、释放后使用，或某个返回路径遗漏了已分配的内存。

paragraphs.en: The analyser handles functions whose return type PrimeVul has stripped from the first line, attribute macros, sizeof operands, pool allocators and returns that follow a free. It is exact for the syntax it models and deliberately does not reason about callers and callees; the notes state this. A function’s obligations are rendered as a numbered list, operations with concerns first, at most twelve per function ( Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该分析器处理以下情形的函数：返回类型被 PrimeVul 从第一行剥离、属性宏、sizeof 操作数、池分配器，以及紧跟在 free 之后的返回。 对于它所建模的语法它是精确的，并且有意不对调用者与被调用者进行推理；注释中说明了这一点。 函数的义务以编号列表的形式呈现，存在关注点的操作排在前面，每个函数至多十二项（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: For every pair we derive six evidence conditions ( Table 1 ). Relevance is defined by the patch: an obligation is patch-relevant if its operation, or a line its concerns refer to, lies near a changed hunk (three lines before to eight lines after) and it mentions an identifier that occurs in the changed lines. The patch is used only to build the conditions; the model never sees it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每一对，我们推导出六个证据条件（表 1）。 相关性由补丁定义：如果某个义务的操作，或其关注点所指的某一行，位于变更代码块附近（之前三行到之后八行），并且提到了变更行中出现的标识符，则该义务是补丁相关的。 补丁仅用于构建条件；模型从不看到它。

sents.zh: 对于每一对，我们推导出六个证据条件（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: False evidence is constructed so that it can be refuted by reading the function. In C4 every concern of the patch-relevant obligations of the vulnerable version is replaced by a fabricated guarantee that cites a concrete line (for instance “ pps_id >= 0 is checked before this access (line 12)” where line 12 is return -1; ). In C5 the patched version receives the concerns that the patch removed, transplanted onto the same kind of operation, with the contradicting guard facts deleted; when no such concern exists, a true guard of a patch-relevant (or, failing that, any) operation is declared not to protect it. We record which of the three constructions was used.
paragraphs.zh: 构造假证据，使其能够通过阅读函数而被驳倒。 在 C4 中，易受攻击版本中与补丁相关义务的所有关注点都被一个引用具体行的伪造保证所取代（例如“pps_id >= 0 在此访问之前已被检查（第 12 行）”，而第 12 行实际是 return -1;）。 在 C5 中，被修补版本被赋予了补丁所移除的关注点，这些关注点被移植到同类操作上，并删除了相矛盾的守卫事实；当不存在此类关注点时，则宣称与补丁相关（或退而求其次，任意）操作的某个真守卫不能保护它。 我们记录使用了这三种构造中的哪一种。

paragraphs.en: A verdict is correct if it is VULNERABLE for a vulnerable version and SAFE for a patched one. paragraphs.en: For RQ3 we need to know whether an answer disputes a note. LLMs can match or exceed crowd workers on some annotation tasks [ 69 ] , but their reliability for software engineering artefacts varies by task and must be checked against human labels [ 70 ] ; we therefore validate both the automatic rule and the LLM annotators. A lexical rule flags answers that state that a note is wrong, inaccurate, a false positive or does not match the code. To validate it, we drew 80 C4 / C5 answers stratified by the rule (40 flagged, 40 not). Two LLM annotators (Claude and deepseek-v4-pro ) labelled each answer independently with a written guide (Appendix B ): whether it checks a note against the code, whether it rejects a false note, and whether its verdict relies on a note at face value. Agreement is measured with Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 71 ] . The first author independently labelled a random subset of 20 answers. Population rates are estimated by reweighting the strata with the rule’s hit rate among all C4 / C5 answers.
paragraphs.zh: 对于RQ3，我们需要知道一个回答是否反驳了某条笔记。 大语言模型在某些标注任务上可以比肩甚至超越众包工人 [ 69 ]，但其在软件工程制品上的可靠性因任务而异，必须对照人工标签进行检验 [ 70 ]；因此我们同时对自动规则和大语言模型标注者进行了验证。 一条词法规则会标记出那些声称某条笔记是错误的、不准确的、误报的或与代码不匹配的回答。 为验证该规则，我们按规则分层抽取了80个C4 / C5回答（40个被标记，40个未被标记）。 两个大语言模型标注者（Claude和deepseek-v4-pro）依据一份书面指南（附录B）独立标注每个回答：它是否将某条笔记与代码进行核对、它是否拒绝了错误的笔记，以及它的结论是否仅凭笔记的表面内容。 一致性用Cohen的κ \kappa系数 [ 71 ] 来衡量。 第一作者独立标注了随机抽取的20个回答子集。 总体比例通过利用该规则在所有C4 / C5回答中的命中率对各层重新加权来估计。

paragraphs.en: We use four model configurations from two vendors: DeepSeek’s flash model without reasoning ( deepseek-chat ) and with reasoning ( deepseek-flash ), the larger deepseek-v4-pro with reasoning, and Alibaba’s qwen-plus-2025-12-01 without reasoning. Reasoning models run at the low reasoning effort; at the default effort their reasoning frequently exhausted a 32k-token budget before a verdict was produced. All calls use temperature 0; budgets are 8k tokens for non-reasoning and 32k for reasoning models. Because the larger reasoning model needs about six minutes per call, it was run on a random 60-pair subset of the study set and only on C0 , C2 , C4 and C5 ; qwen-plus was run on C2 , C4 and C5 .

paragraphs.en: Three reasons motivate this choice. First, only constructed evidence lets us know the truth of every note and compare a false note with a true note about the same operation; with a production tool, the truth of each warning would have to be established by hand and could not be varied on the same function. Second, the obligation format states guarantees and concerns explicitly, which is the information that pipelines pass to the model and the distinction our questions are about. Third, keeping the code, model and task fixed while only the notes change is what makes the contrasts paired and the effects attributable. We view evidence from production analysers as a complementary, not competing, direction ( Section 7.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三个原因促使我们做出这一选择。 首先，只有构造出的证据才能让我们知道每条注释的真伪，并就同一操作将错误注释与正确注释进行比较；若使用生产工具，每条警告的真伪都必须人工确认，且无法在同一函数上进行变化。 其次，义务格式显式地陈述了保证与关注点，而这些正是流水线传递给模型的信息，也是我们的问题所要考察的区分点。 第三，保持代码、模型和任务不变而只改变注释，正是这种做法使得对比成为配对的，并使效应可以归因。 我们将来自生产分析器的证据视为一种互补而非竞争的方向（第 7.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 shows accuracy per condition, separately for vulnerable and patched versions. Two observations stand out. First, the models differ mainly in their bias , not in their discrimination. Without evidence ( C0 ), deepseek-chat judges 36% of the functions vulnerable and finds 45% of the vulnerable versions, whereas deepseek-flash with reasoning judges 69% vulnerable, finds 78% of the vulnerable versions, but clears only 36% of the patched ones. The larger deepseek-v4-pro is even more inclined to flag (79% on its 60-pair subset). Reasoning thus shifts the operating point towards suspicion rather than separating the two versions of a pair better.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了各条件下的准确率，分别针对易受攻击版本和已修复版本。 有两点观察结果值得关注。 首先，各模型的差异主要体现在其偏差上，而非其区分能力上。 在没有证据的情况下（C0），deepseek-chat判定36%的函数易受攻击，并找出45%的易受攻击版本，而带推理的deepseek-flash判定69%易受攻击，找出78%的易受攻击版本，但只放行了36%的已修复版本。 更大的deepseek-v4-pro更加倾向于标记（在其60对子集上为79%）。 因此，推理将工作点推向怀疑，而不是更好地区分一对中的两个版本。

paragraphs.en: False assurances mislead. When the notes on a vulnerable function claim that the relevant check exists ( C4 ), the accuracy of deepseek-chat drops from 0.75 to 0.64 relative to the true notes ( C2 ): ten vulnerable functions that were found with true notes are cleared with false ones, and only one moves in the other direction ( p = 0.012 p=0.012 ). The larger deepseek-v4-pro shows the same drop on its 60-pair subset ( 0.97 → 0.83 0.97\to 0.83 , CI − 0.28 -0.28 to − 0.03 -0.03 , p = 0.125 p=0.125 given only 29 functions). paragraphs.en: The answers show how the asymmetry arises. Faced with an alarm, the models typically go to the cited operation, quote the guard and conclude that the note “appears to be a false positive”. Faced with an assurance, they more often restate it as a fact (“the static analysis notes confirm …”) and move on to other operations. A claim that a check is missing invites a search for the check; a claim that it is present ends the search.

paragraphs.en: A different reading is that false assurances are simply harder to refute: refuting an alarm means finding a check that exists, whereas refuting an assurance means establishing that a check is absent. To separate not checking from not being able to check, we ran the verification call of verify-show (Appendix A ), unchanged, with deepseek-chat on every claim of the C2 , C4 and C5 notes of the study set (357 calls). A claim of C4 or C5 counts as false if it does not occur among the true C2 claims of the same function. When asked to check, the model refuted false assurances about as often as false alarms ( Table 4 ): 0.76 versus 0.79 of the claims. It also discriminated well between true and false assurances (2% of true holds-here claims refuted), whereas it refuted 45% of the true concerns, a general scepticism towards alarms that matches the backfire in RQ2. At the level of functions the picture is less even: on the 57 pairs with both conditions, all false claims were refuted for 36 vulnerable versions under C4 and for 48 patched versions under C5 (difference − 0.21 -0.21 , 95% CI − 0.37 -0.37 to − 0.05 -0.05 ). Among the false alarms, those that negate a guard of an arbitrary operation were refuted less often (0.70) than transplanted concerns (0.93) and negated guards of relevant operations (1.00). Overall, the model is able to refute most false assurances once it is asked to, which supports the reading that the asymmetry in the audits arises mainly from whether the model checks a claim rather than from whether it can; the residual function-level difference shows that the two cannot be fully separated in this design, since the direction of a claim is tied to whether refuting it requires finding a check or establishing its absence. This check used one model.

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ3. The three DeepSeek configurations verify false alarms against the code far more often than false assurances (annotated: roughly three in four versus one in two answers). We call this pattern asymmetric scrutiny : evidence that the code is safe is trusted, evidence that it is unsafe is checked. It is not universal: qwen-plus checks assurances at least as often as alarms, and it is also the model that false assurances do not mislead. When explicitly asked to check, deepseek-chat refutes false assurances about as often as false alarms (0.76 vs. 0.79 of the claims), so the gap lies mainly in whether the claims are checked.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 的回答。 三种 DeepSeek 配置针对代码验证虚假警报的频率远高于虚假保证（注：大约四分之三的答案对一半）。 我们将这种模式称为不对称审查：表明代码安全的证据会被信任，而表明代码不安全的证据则会被核查。 这一模式并非普遍存在：qwen-plus 核查保证的频率至少与核查警报一样高，它也是唯一不被虚假保证误导的模型。 当被明确要求进行核查时，deepseek-chat 驳斥虚假保证的频率与虚假警报大致相同（分别为 0.76 与 0.79 的声明），因此差距主要在于声明是否会被核查。

paragraphs.en: Of the first four strategies, reframing assurances as claims to verify was by far the most effective: accuracy under false assurances rose from 0.64 to 0.82 (16 functions gained, one lost; Holm-adjusted p = 0.001 p=0.001 ) with no significant loss under true evidence. Asking the model to quote the code before relying on a note helped less ( + 0.11 +0.11 , Holm p = 0.15 p=0.15 ). Removing assurances altogether (alarms) and showing provenance had no effect on false assurances, and removing assurances cost 10 points of recall under true relevant evidence ( p = 0.021 p=0.021 ): the assurances that mislead under C4 are useful under C2 . Showing provenance did not help even though the printed source line contradicted the false note; the models did not use the contradiction unless asked to check.

paragraphs.en: On the development set we compared four strategies that move the checking out of the audit or before it ( Fig. 9 , development rows). Checking each claim in a separate call and listing the refuted claims next to the confirmed notes (verify-show, Fig. 8 ) raised accuracy under false assurances from 0.59 to 0.72 (18 gained, 5 lost; Holm-adjusted p = 0.032 p=0.032 ) without a significant loss under true evidence. Withholding the refuted claims instead (verify) helped less ( + 0.06 +0.06 ): the explicit statement that the code contradicts a note appears to matter, not just its absence. Committing to an initial verdict before seeing the notes (commit) was the only strategy that made true evidence useful ( + 0.05 +0.05 under C1 , p = 0.023 p=0.023 ; + 0.09 +0.09 on patched versions under C2 , p = 0.076 p=0.076 ), but it did little against false assurances ( + 0.05 +0.05 ), and combining it with verification did not add the two effects ( + 0.06 +0.06 under C4 ). Following the rule we had fixed in advance, verify-show became the final strategy.

paragraphs.en: H2, the replication of deference, gave mixed results. For deepseek-chat , accuracy under false assurances was 0.06 lower than under true evidence on the same functions, but the difference was not significant (CI − 0.14 -0.14 to + 0.01 +0.01 , p = 0.15 p=0.15 ); the direction agrees with the study set ( − 0.11 -0.11 ) and the held-out set ( − 0.09 -0.09 ). paragraphs.en: The answers suggest a simple mechanism. An alarm states that something is missing at a specific operation; the natural response is to look for it, and when the model looks, it usually finds the guard that the alarm denies. An assurance states that the work has already been done; it gives the model a reason to stop looking at that operation and to spend its reasoning elsewhere. In this sense the asymmetry is not a failure to read the code (the models read the relevant lines correctly when they look at them, Section 3 ) but a failure to look. The same allocation of attention is familiar from human automation bias, where errors of commission arise when an aid’s output replaces the verification it was meant to support [ 6 , 55 , 7 ] . In the terms of Lee and See [ 54 ] , the models’ reliance on the tool is miscalibrated in one direction only. We read the answers as consistent with this mechanism; the study does not demonstrate it directly.
paragraphs.zh: 这些答案提示了一种简单的机制。 警报声明在某个特定操作处缺失了某些东西；自然的反应是去寻找它，而当模型去查看时，它通常会发现该警报所否认的守卫。 保证声明这项工作已经完成；它给了模型一个理由，使其不再查看该操作，而将推理能力用在别处。 从这个意义上说，这种不对称并非读取代码的失败（当模型查看相关代码行时，它们能正确读取，见第 3 节），而是未能去查看。 这种注意力的分配与人类的自动化偏误相似，在后者中，当辅助工具的输出取代了它本应支持的验证时，就会产生执行错误 [6, 55, 7]。 用 Lee 和 See [54] 的术语来说，模型对该工具的依赖只在一个方向上校准失准。 我们将这些答案解读为与该机制一致；本研究并未直接证明它。

sents.en: In this sense the asymmetry is not a failure to read the code (the models read the relevant lines correctly when they look at them, Section 3 ) but a failure to look.
sents.zh: 从这个意义上说，这种不对称并非读取代码的失败（当模型查看相关代码行时，它们能正确读取，见第 3 节），而是未能去查看。

sents.en: The same allocation of attention is familiar from human automation bias, where errors of commission arise when an aid’s output replaces the verification it was meant to support [ 6 , 55 , 7 ] .
sents.zh: 这种注意力的分配与人类的自动化偏误相似，在后者中，当辅助工具的输出取代了它本应支持的验证时，就会产生执行错误 [6, 55, 7]。

sents.zh: 用 Lee 和 See [54] 的术语来说，模型对该工具的依赖只在一个方向上校准失准。

sents.en: We read the answers as consistent with this mechanism; the study does not demonstrate it directly.
sents.zh: 我们将这些答案解读为与该机制一致；本研究并未直接证明它。

paragraphs.en: Other explanations are compatible with the data. Assistants trained to agree with their users may agree more readily with statements that reduce the scope of the task [ 13 ] , and the security-oriented framing of our prompts may make alarms feel more salient than reassurances. Our study does not separate these explanations; it establishes that the asymmetry exists, that it is not specific to one model or vendor, and that it also appears in a direction-aware measure that compares each kind of false evidence with true notes about the same operations. It also qualifies the conclusion of concurrent work that contextual cues mainly change a model’s willingness to flag code [ 14 ] : for claims that can be checked against the code, the direction of the claim decides whether it is checked. The observation that blunt attempts to bias LLM code reviewers can raise suspicion [ 15 ] fits the same pattern: the models scrutinise what looks like an attempt to change their verdict, and an alarm is such an attempt in a way that a quiet assurance is not.

paragraphs.en: Two boundary conditions recur in the data. First, a model’s leaning limits how much any evidence can move it: the exception kimi-k2.6 flags almost every function, has little to gain from scrutiny and little to lose to an assurance, and is moved by neither kind of false evidence. Second, the size of deference varies between samples of the same model. On the study set qwen-plus appeared immune to false assurances because it flags most functions; on the test set the same model lost 11 points to them, and the direction-aware measure showed the same tendency as for the other models. Accuracy is therefore a poor measure of deference. The models we studied differ more in their leaning than in their discrimination ( Section 6.1 ), and a model’s leaning determines how much room evidence has to move it in either direction. Studies that evaluate LLM pipelines with analysis evidence should report, at least, the shift towards the evidence’s claim relative to a matched baseline, separately for evidence that argues for and against a vulnerability. The mitigation has its own boundary: verify-show helped deepseek-chat in the pre-specified test but gave a smaller, non-significant gain for qwen-plus , whose answers it changed less.
paragraphs.zh: 数据中反复出现两种边界条件。 其一，模型的倾向限制了任何证据能够推动它的幅度：例外样本 kimi-k2.6 几乎标记每一个函数，从审查中获益甚少，也不会因保证而损失什么，因此两类虚假证据都无法使它动摇。 其二，同一个模型在不同样本上的遵从幅度存在差异。 在研究集上，qwen-plus 由于标记了大多数函数，似乎对虚假保证免疫；而在测试集上，同一模型因虚假保证损失了 11 个百分点，方向感知的度量显示出的趋势与其他模型相同。 因此，准确率是衡量遵从性的糟糕指标。 我们研究的模型在倾向上的差异大于在判别力上的差异（第 6.1 节），而模型的倾向决定了证据在任一方向上有多大空间可以推动它。 使用分析证据评估大语言模型流水线的研究，至少应报告相对于匹配基线、向证据主张的偏移量，并分别针对支持漏洞和反对漏洞的证据加以报告。 该缓解措施本身也有边界：verify-show 在预先指定的测试中帮助了 deepseek-chat，但对 qwen-plus 带来的收益更小且不显著，因为它对后者答案的改变较少。

paragraphs.en: Pipelines that let an LLM triage static-analysis alarms rely on the direction of evidence that the models already check. Pipelines that pass the analyser’s guarantees to the model (for example that a value is bounded, that a pointer is checked, or that a path is infeasible) rely on the direction that the models trust. An incorrect guarantee, whether caused by an unsound analysis, a stale result or an adversary, is likely to propagate into the model’s verdict. Guarantees should be verified before they reach the auditor, or presented with their provenance and an explicit instruction to verify them in a separate step.
paragraphs.zh: 让大语言模型对静态分析告警进行分流的流水线，依赖于这些模型已经检查的证据方向。 将分析器的保证传递给模型的流水线（例如某个值是有界的、某个指针已被检查、或某条路径不可行），依赖于模型所信任的方向。 一个不正确的保证，无论是源于不健全的分析、过时的结果还是攻击者，都很可能会传播到模型的判定中。 这些保证在到达审计者之前应先加以验证，或者在呈现时附上其来源，并给出明确的指令要求在单独的步骤中对其进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Instructions inside the audit prompt were fragile: asking the model to quote the code before relying on a note helped little, and reframing assurances as claims to verify, the best instruction on the study set, did not replicate. Showing the source line that contradicts a note did not help either; the models did not use the contradiction unless asked to check. What worked was moving the check out of the audit: a separate call verifies each claim against the code, and the audit receives the result. This mirrors Chain-of-Verification, where answering verification questions independently of the draft is essential to its effect [ 53 ] , and is consistent with the finding that self-correction succeeds mainly when it can draw on a reliable external reference [ 52 ] , here the code itself. It also matches the human finding that explanations reduce over-reliance when they make verification easy [ 57 ] , and the adversarial finding that isolating the code from unverifiable comments defends LLM detectors better than instructions to distrust them [ 16 ] . Verify-show doubles the number of calls; the verification call is short, since it returns a JSON array of statuses, but its cost is not negligible. Withholding refuted claims (verify) was less effective than showing them as contradicted: an explicit statement that the code contradicts a claim appears to correct the auditor, whereas the mere absence of a claim does not.
paragraphs.zh: 审计提示词中的指令十分脆弱：要求模型在依赖某条注释前先引用代码，收效甚微；而将保证性表述重构为待验证的断言——这是研究集上效果最好的指令——也未能复现。 展示与注释相矛盾的那一行源代码同样没有帮助；除非被明确要求核查，否则模型不会利用这种矛盾。 真正有效的是把核查环节移出审计过程：由一次单独的调用对照代码验证每条断言，审计过程则接收验证结果。 这与「验证链」（Chain-of-Verification）相呼应——独立于草稿回答验证性问题正是其发挥作用的关键 [53]，也与「自我纠错主要在能借助可靠外部参照时才奏效」这一发现一致 [52]，而这里的外部参照就是代码本身。 这也与人类研究中的发现相符——当解释使验证变得容易时，它们能减少过度依赖 [57]；还与对抗性研究中的发现相符——把代码与不可验证的注释隔离开来，比「不信任注释」的指令更能有效保护 LLM 检测器 [16]。 先验证后展示会使调用次数翻倍；验证调用很短，因为它只返回一个状态组成的 JSON 数组，但其成本不可忽略。 隐去被驳斥的断言（验证方案）不如将其标记为与代码矛盾后展示来得有效：明确指出代码与某条断言相矛盾似乎能纠正审计者，而单纯缺失某条断言则不能。

paragraphs.en: True evidence did little in our study, and only the commit-first strategy, in which the model audits the function before seeing the notes and then reconsiders, made it measurably useful on the development set. Commit-first is a cognitive forcing function in the sense of Buçinca et al. [ 8 ] : it ensures that the model forms its own judgement before the tool can anchor it. Its effects did not add up with those of verification in our combination, and it was not tested on the test set; whether a better combination exists is an open question.

paragraphs.en: The failed replication of the reframing strategy is a cautionary example. Selected among four strategies on 83 functions, it raised accuracy by 18 points with a Holm-adjusted p p of 0.001, yet on 66 held-out functions the gain fell to 8 points and was not significant. Prompt variants are cheap to generate and to evaluate, which makes selection effects of this kind easy to produce and hard to notice. Separating development and test data, freezing the strategy, and fixing the hypothesis before the test is run cost us one additional dataset and a few days; it is what allowed us to report the verify-show result with confidence, and the H1b result with honesty.
paragraphs.zh: 重构策略复现失败是一个警示性案例。 该策略在83个函数上从四种策略中被选出，将准确率提升了18个百分点，经Holm校正后的p值为0.001；但在66个留出函数上，增益降至8个百分点且不显著。 提示词变体的生成和评估都很廉价，这使得此类选择效应容易产生却难以察觉。 将开发数据与测试数据分离、冻结该策略、并在运行检验前固定假设，只多花了一个数据集和几天时间；正是这一点让我们能够有把握地报告verify-show结果，并诚实地报告H1b结果。

paragraphs.en: Our evidence is produced by our own analyser and manipulated by construction, not taken from a production tool. This is deliberate, since it lets us control the truth and relevance of every note, but real tools phrase their output differently and are wrong in different ways. Our false assurances are refutable by reading the function, and they cite a concrete line; real incorrect guarantees may be harder to refute, which would make the deference we measure a lower bound. Relevance is defined through the fix, which approximates but does not equal what matters for the vulnerability. The behavioural coding of RQ3 relies on a lexical cue; we validated it against two independent LLM annotators and a human check of 20 items, found it conservative (precision 0.97–1.00, recall 0.70–0.76), and report reweighted annotated rates. The annotators are LLMs; the agreement with the first author’s labels was perfect on the checked subset, but the subset is small. The cue was validated on DeepSeek answers; we read a sample of flagged qwen-plus answers but did not formally validate it for the models of the replication.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的证据由我们自己的分析器产生并通过构造加以操控，而非取自生产工具。 这是有意为之，因为它让我们能够控制每条笔记的真实性与相关性，但真实工具的输出措辞不同，出错方式也不同。 我们的虚假保证可以通过阅读函数来反驳，并且它们引用了具体的行；真实的不正确保证可能更难反驳，这将使我们测得的遵从度成为下界。 相关性通过修复来定义，这近似但不完全等同于对漏洞真正重要的内容。 RQ3 的行为编码依赖于一个词汇线索；我们用两个独立的 LLM 标注者和对 20 个条目的人工检查对其进行了验证，发现它偏保守（精确率 0.97–1.00，召回率 0.70–0.76），并报告了重新加权后的标注率。 标注者是 LLM；在被检查的子集上，其与第一作者标签的一致性是完全的，但该子集很小。 该线索是在 DeepSeek 的回答上验证的；我们阅读了被标记的 qwen-plus 回答的样本，但未对复现中的模型进行正式验证。

paragraphs.en: All comparisons are paired on the same functions and differ only in the notes or their presentation. Responses at temperature 0 are not fully deterministic [ 61 ] , so some discordant pairs reflect noise; noise affects both directions of a McNemar test equally and cannot create a systematic difference, but it lowers power. The direction-aware measure was defined after seeing the first four configurations; we therefore treat those results as exploratory and confirmed the measure on seven new models under an internal registration ( Section 5.3 ). We also examined, and rejected before the registration, an alternative analysis (flip rates conditioned on the baseline verdict) after finding that it is dominated by regression to the mean. Responses without a verdict are counted as wrong in accuracy and as neither verdict in the direction-aware measure, which is why the two can differ (for deepseek-chat , two of the ten vulnerable functions lost under C4 were left without a verdict rather than judged SAFE); they are rare (at most 3.2% for all configurations except kimi-k2.6 with 6.5%).
paragraphs.zh: 所有对比均在相同的函数上配对进行，仅在注释或其呈现方式上有所不同。 温度为 0 时的响应并非完全确定 [61]，因此某些不一致的配对反映了噪声；噪声对 McNemar 检验的两个方向影响相同，不会造成系统性差异，但会降低检验功效。 方向感知的度量是在看到前四个配置之后才定义的；因此我们将这些结果视为探索性的，并在内部预注册下于七个新模型上验证了该度量（第 5.3 节）。 我们还考察过并在注册之前否决了另一种分析（以基线判定为条件的翻转率），因为发现它主要受均值回归的影响。 没有给出判定的响应在准确率中计为错误，在方向感知度量中计为两种判定都不是，这就是两者可能不一致的原因（对于 deepseek-chat，在 C4 下失去的十个易受攻击函数中有两个未被给出判定，而非被判为 SAFE）；这种情况很少见（除 kimi-k2.6 为 6.5% 外，所有配置至多为 3.2%）。

paragraphs.en: We study C/C++ functions of at most 150 lines (300 on the held-out set) with structural CWEs, audited in isolation; longer functions, other languages, inter-procedural evidence and agentic settings may behave differently. PrimeVul’s labels are validated but not free of noise, and the vulnerable version of a pair may contain issues beyond the one fixed. The models are accessed through vendor APIs; we pin dated snapshots where the vendor offers them, but undated model names may change behind the API, and we cannot rule out that PrimeVul functions appear in the models’ training data [ 60 ] . Such contamination would affect all conditions of a function alike and cannot explain differences between them. Results may also depend on the wording of our prompts [ 62 ] ; we used one wording per condition and presentation, and the replication across eleven configurations reduces, but does not eliminate, this threat. Models were run without reasoning, except for two DeepSeek configurations at low reasoning effort; the reasoning configurations showed the same asymmetry, but we did not vary the reasoning effort. Results for deepseek-v4-pro are based on a 60-pair subset. The mitigation was tested on two models; its effect on qwen-plus was half as large and not significant, so we do not claim that it generalises across models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究至多150行（留出集上为300行）的C/C++函数，这些函数具有结构性CWE且在孤立状态下审计；更长的函数、其他语言、过程间证据以及智能体设置可能表现不同。 PrimeVul的标签经过验证但并非没有噪声，且一对函数中脆弱版本的函数可能包含被修复问题之外的其他问题。 模型通过厂商API访问；在厂商提供日期快照时我们固定使用该快照，但无日期的模型名称可能在API背后发生变化，并且我们不能排除PrimeVul函数出现在模型训练数据中的可能性[60]。 此类数据污染会同等影响某个函数的所有实验条件，因此无法解释它们之间的差异。 结果也可能取决于我们提示词的措辞[62]；我们在每个条件和呈现方式下只使用一种措辞，而在十一种配置上的复现降低了但并未消除这一威胁。 模型均在不启用推理的情况下运行，仅有两个DeepSeek配置以低推理力度运行；这些推理配置表现出相同的不对称性，但我们并未改变推理力度。 deepseek-v4-pro的结果基于一个60对函数的子集。 该缓解措施在两个模型上进行了测试；其对qwen-plus的效果只有一半且不显著，因此我们不声称它能泛化到其他模型。

paragraphs.en: We report paired exact tests, bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm corrections where several strategies are compared with a baseline. The confirmatory tests use the analyses fixed in advance; only H3 has a registration document with hashes, and that registration is internal ( Section 5.3 ). The pooled analysis of deference across the three sets ( Section 6.5 ) was not pre-specified and is labelled post hoc. Several per-model results rest on 60–90 functions and have wide intervals; we base our conclusions on the pooled and confirmatory tests rather than on individual models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了配对精确检验、自助法置信区间，以及在将多种策略与基线进行比较时使用的 Holm 校正。 验证性检验采用事先固定的分析方案；只有 H3 有带哈希值的注册文件，且该注册是内部的（第 5.3 节）。 对三组数据集的顺从性进行合并分析（第 6.5 节）并非预先设定，故被标注为事后分析。 若干按模型划分的结果仅基于 60–90 个函数，且区间较宽；我们的结论基于合并分析与验证性检验，而非单个模型。

paragraphs.en: We studied how LLM vulnerability auditors use static-analysis evidence by auditing the same functions under evidence that differed only in relevance, truth and presentation, on 916 PrimeVul pairs with eleven model configurations from four vendors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了 LLM 漏洞审计智能体如何使用静态分析证据，方法是在 916 个 PrimeVul 对上，使用来自四个厂商的十一种模型配置，对相同函数进行审计，所用证据仅在相关性、真实性和呈现方式上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: True evidence barely improved the audits. Showing all true notes changed accuracy by + 0.02 +0.02 ; relevant notes gave a small, non-significant gain.
paragraphs.zh: 真实证据几乎没有改善审计结果。 展示所有真实笔记对准确率的影响为 +0.02；相关笔记仅带来微小且不显著的提升。

sents.en: True evidence barely improved the audits.
sents.zh: 真实证据几乎没有改善审计结果。

sents.en: Showing all true notes changed accuracy by + 0.02 +0.02 ; relevant notes gave a small, non-significant gain.
sents.zh: 展示所有真实笔记对准确率的影响为 +0.02；相关笔记仅带来微小且不显著的提升。

paragraphs.en: False evidence acted asymmetrically. Fabricated assurances that a check exists pulled verdicts towards SAFE and lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities, whereas fabricated alarms were checked against the code and often made the model clear the function. The asymmetry was confirmed in an internally registered replication on seven models that were not used to derive it; its size varies between models and samples.
paragraphs.zh: 虚假证据的作用是不对称的。 捏造的“存在检查”的保证会使判定偏向 SAFE，并降低对真实漏洞的检测，而捏造的警报则会与代码进行核对，往往使模型将函数判定为无问题。 这种不对称性在内部登记的复现实验中得到证实，实验使用了七个未参与推导该结论的智能体模型；其大小因模型和样本而异。

sents.en: False evidence acted asymmetrically.
sents.zh: 虚假证据的作用是不对称的。

paragraphs.en: Separate verification helped; instructions did not reliably. Instructions within the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference, and the most promising one failed to replicate; verifying each claim in a separate step and showing the refuted claims did, in a pre-specified test for one of two models, without reducing the value of true evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 分开验证有帮助；而指令并不可靠。 审计提示中的指令并不可靠地减少顺从倾向，其中最有希望的一条也未能复现；在针对两个模型之一的一项预先设定的测试中，将每条声明放在单独步骤中验证并展示被驳斥的声明确实有效，且不会降低真实证据的价值。

sents.en: Separate verification helped; instructions did not reliably.
sents.zh: 分开验证有帮助；而指令并不可靠。

sents.en: Instructions within the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference, and the most promising one failed to replicate; verifying each claim in a separate step and showing the refuted claims did, in a pre-specified test for one of two models, without reducing the value of true evidence.

paragraphs.en: Treat the analyser’s guarantees, not its alarms, as the input that most needs checking in LLM–analysis pipelines.

paragraphs.en: The findings are bounded by C/C++ functions audited in isolation, evidence from our own analyser, and models accessed through vendor APIs. Future work should (i) study evidence from production analysers; (ii) extend the study to inter-procedural and agentic settings; (iii) test verification strategies on more models; and (iv) find ways to make true evidence useful without making false evidence harmful.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的结论受限于以下条件：审计对象是孤立分析的 C/C++ 函数，证据来自我们自己的分析器，以及通过供应商 API 访问的模型。 未来的工作应当：(i) 研究来自生产环境分析器的证据；(ii) 将研究扩展到跨过程和智能体（agentic）场景；(iii) 在更多模型上测试验证策略；以及 (iv) 探索让真证据发挥作用而不会使假证据造成危害的方法。
